title: Keep the scene. Send the changes.
idea: Scrub a synthetic 3D set beside its cached approximation. Compare a position-only ranking with position-and-color ranking; watch a stationary surface go stale.
controls: Update budget, frame-group length, time, ranking, color-change toggle, orbit; one-click PNG/GIF in square or wide format.
misconception: Stationary means unchanged, or caching a splat removes its rendering cost.
connection: ResStreamGS · 15 Oct 2026. Implemented analytic scene. Known synthetic trajectories rank updates; not its learned probe, training, codec or mobile benchmark. Record counts are not compressed bytes.
recommendation: Best pairing this week. A visible failure you can cause, diagnose and fix.

title: One cell can contain several things
idea: Project colored splats onto three planes. Compare mean pooling with a toy multi-slot assignment and occupancy-controlled decoding.
controls: Collision density, slots per cell, attention temperature, occupancy threshold and candidate cap; planned PNG/GIF.
misconception: One pooled feature preserves every overlapping primitive, or adaptive output counts are unlimited.
connection: TriFold · 16 Oct 2026. Proposed analytic pooling illustration, no learned encoder or generated scene.

title: All the words can be present—and still be wrong
idea: Drag colored layout boxes and compare exact-string accuracy with multiset OCR recall on a deliberately reordered sentence.
controls: Text, line breaks, duplicate/extra words, canvas ratio, coordinate system and box overlap; planned PNG/GIF.
misconception: A high text-coverage score means every word is correct and in the right place.
connection: MOSS-Image · 16 Oct 2026. Proposed layout/metric lab; no generated poster or model inference.

title: A box tells the model where. A mask enforces where.
idea: Drag a conditioning box over a synthetic image. Compare soft spatial influence with hard compositing and measure outside-region change.
controls: Box size/location, influence falloff, hard-mask toggle and restoration stage; planned PNG/GIF.
misconception: Bounding-box conditioning guarantees unchanged pixels outside the box.
connection: FLUX 3 Image Klein · 15 Oct 2026. Proposed analytic influence field, not measured model leakage.

title: An event, a sound, and a preserved voice are different tests
idea: Scrub video-event, dialogue, music and Foley lanes. Compare alignment, per-track editability and waveform differences independently.
controls: Offset in milliseconds, mute/solo, cut position, ambience continuity and regenerated-dialogue toggle; planned PNG/GIF and synthetic audio.
misconception: Synchronized audio is necessarily editable, or preserved dialogue means identical samples.
connection: Instant Soundtracks · 15 Oct; Mirelo SFX 2.0 · 14 Oct 2026. Proposed synthetic timeline; no vendor outputs.

title: Less uncertainty does not guarantee a better answer
idea: Track categorical predictions through refinement, showing entropy and correctness separately, including a confidently wrong trajectory.
controls: Residual strength, contraction target, policy refresh interval, shift and update size; planned PNG/GIF.
misconception: Entropy contraction proves correctness, or system throughput isolates a training-method improvement.
connection: ORL · 14 Oct 2026. Proposed synthetic dynamics; not an ORL training or speed reproduction.

title: Spend detail on recent frames
idea: Pack recent and older frame tiles into different-resolution memory buckets while tracking identity reference and lip timing.
controls: History length, patch scale by age, chunk boundary, detail frequency and audio offset; planned PNG/GIF.
misconception: Bounded visual memory guarantees unlimited identity consistency, or fewer model calls equal proportional end-to-end speedup.
connection: Kandinsky S2V · 13 Oct 2026. Proposed memory schematic; no generated avatar.

title: The right token can be the wrong next step
idea: Show a commit-order tree and fresh target verification, counting both forward batches and candidate states.
controls: Branch width, stale/fresh shift, temperature and shared sampling noise; planned PNG/GIF.
misconception: A correct token at the wrong position is an acceptable draft, or fewer forward calls means less total work.
connection: SPOT · 15 Oct 2026. Proposed synthetic categorical verifier. Exactness excludes the paper's approximate-cache transfer rows.
